## `gearu`

```text
usage: gearu [-h] [--version] {plan,release} ...

Make repositories ready for release.

positional arguments:
  {plan,release}
    plan          validate and display a release plan
    release       prepare, verify, commit, and tag a release

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --version       show program's version number and exit

Project: https://github.com/owebeeone/gearu
```

## `gearu plan`

```text
usage: gearu plan [-h] [--repo REPO] [--dependency-tag NAME=TAG] version

positional arguments:
  version               explicit release version, e.g. 1.2.3 or v1.2.3

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           repository or a path inside it (default: current directory)
  --dependency-tag NAME=TAG
                        override one configured dependency tag; repeat as needed
```

## `gearu release`

```text
usage: gearu release [-h] [--repo REPO] [--dependency-tag NAME=TAG] [--push]
                     [--github-release]
                     version

positional arguments:
  version               explicit release version, e.g. 1.2.3 or v1.2.3

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           repository or a path inside it (default: current directory)
  --dependency-tag NAME=TAG
                        override one configured dependency tag; repeat as needed
  --push                atomically push the exact branch commit and tag
  --github-release      create the GitHub Release after pushing the tag (requires
                        --push)
```
